title: Targeting a transcription factor NF-kappaB by green tea catechins using in silico and in vitro studies in pancreatic cancer.
authors: Suhail, Mohd; Rehan, Mohd; Tarique, Mohammad; Tabrez, Shams; Husain, Amjad; Zughaibi, Torki A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和体外实验研究绿茶儿茶素对NF-kappaB转录因子的抑制机制，虽涉及TF-DNA相关靶点但未聚焦DNA结合建模，方法以对接为主且偏药物筛选应用。
abstract: Pancreatic cancer remains a lethal disease and a major public health problem globally. Nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) has been identified as a therapeutic target in several cancers and plays an important role in inflammatory responses. Many phytochemicals, including catechins, have been reported in the scientific literature with efficient anticancer potential and minimal side effects. This study aims to gain insights into the inhibitory mechanism of catechin derivatives epicatechin (EC), epigallocatechin (EGC), epicatechin gallate (ECG), and epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) using in silico and in vitro studies especially considering NF-kappaB targeting. We explored the binding pose, interacting residues and molecular interactions for catechin derivatives with NF-kappaB. Docking analysis showed that the catechin derivatives acted as covalent inhibitors with the p65 subunit of NF-kappaB and interacted with other residues through non-bonding interactions and hydrogen bonds. Further, we validated the effect of EGCG on NF-kappaB activity in pancreatic cancer cell lines MIAPaCa-2 and SU 86.86. Our in vitro data showed EGCG effectively reduced cell growth and proliferation, induced apoptosis, and inhibited NF-kappaB activity in the studied cell lines. In addition, EGCG repressed the expression of NF-kappaB target genes including MMP9, MMP2, cMyc, and BCL-2. Thus, targeting NF-kappaB with EGCG could be a potential therapeutic alternative for pancreatic cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 胰腺癌仍然是一种致命疾病，并且是全球主要的公共卫生问题。核因子-kappa B（NF-kappaB）已被确定为多种癌症的治疗靶点，并在炎症反应中发挥重要作用。科学文献中已报道许多植物化学物质，包括儿茶素，具有有效的抗癌潜力且副作用极小。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）研究，特别是针对NF-kappaB靶向，深入了解儿茶素衍生物表儿茶素（EC）、表没食子儿茶素（EGC）、表儿茶素没食子酸酯（ECG）和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯（EGCG）的抑制机制。我们探索了儿茶素衍生物与NF-kappaB的结合姿态、相互作用残基和分子相互作用。对接分析表明，儿茶素衍生物作为共价抑制剂作用于NF-kappaB的p65亚基，并通过非键相互作用和氢键与其他残基相互作用。此外，我们在胰腺癌细胞系MIAPaCa-2和SU 86.86中验证了EGCG对NF-kappaB活性的影响。我们的体外数据显示，EGCG有效降低了所研究细胞系中的细胞生长和增殖，诱导了凋亡，并抑制了NF-kappaB活性。此外，EGCG抑制了NF-kappaB靶基因的表达，包括MMP9、MMP2、cMyc和BCL-2。因此，用EGCG靶向NF-kappaB可能是胰腺癌治疗的潜在替代方案。
